description: Plant memorial aircraft displayed on KnAAZ ground.
Red bort 24. Wears bort number 24; recorded without a tail number because another airframe of this type in the database already carries it.
Blue bort 33. Il-4 of the type built at the Komsomolsk plant during the war; whether the airframe is original or a plant-built reproduction is not established from available sources.
Blue bort 25. Tupolev R-6 (ANT-7), the first type produced at the Komsomolsk plant; original-versus-reproduction status not established.
Red bort 81; previously stood inside the plant near the engineering centre wearing blue 81.
Red bort 70, erected in summer 2012 as a plant memorial aircraft.
Red bort 30, an export-pattern Su-30MKK. c/n 79810380508.
Red bort 23. c/n 36911007905. Wears bort number 23; recorded without a tail number because another airframe of this type in the database already carries it.
Used as a training airframe by the KnAAZ fire service rather than displayed. c/n 5342708.
